title: Switching From Incurred to Expected Loan Loss Provisioning: Early Evidence

scopes.description: The supplied workflow: Stata daily-return construction, multi-file merge, sample/variable construction, discretionary LLP and winsorized dataset; plus the two supplied MATLAB risk/event-return functions and their required handoffs. The release does not supply the full paper's regression scripts.

requirements.description: Author-prepared daily close-price file read as /Stata/Raw_data/Close_price_LLP.dta. LOS_Main.do renames id/day/isin, creates a business calendar, sets Bank_ID by business date, computes a 250-business-calendar-observation lagged log return, then saves all visible rows as past_ret_fyear_end.dta. The later merge requires one row per ISIN-FYear; exact annual selection, FYear mapping, row reduction/key uniqueness, price scaling, identifier crosswalk, and 250-observation prehistory are not established.

routes.description: One-row bounded SAS probe confirms local Datastream primary-exchange quote pricing fields InfoCode, MarketDate, and Close_. It is a compatible product candidate because the datasheet says stock-market data came from Datastream, but no InfoCode-to-ISIN/Bank_ID mapping, field/date conversion, annual filing-row rule, sample/history coverage, or proof that it is the author-prepared Close_price_LLP.dta is supplied.
routes.expected_period: Daily observations covering each required fiscal-year-end report date and at least 250 prior business-calendar observations; exact sample years are unspecified.

requirements.description: Author-prepared bank accounting master file read as /Stata/Raw_data/Accounting.dta. It must supply ISIN and FYear for the master panel and nonmissing FYear rows; the transformed merged panel later uses accounting and supervisory/stage variables, but the package includes no input codebook to allocate every field to its DTA source. Exact product, variable ownership, units, identifiers, fiscal periods, and imputation of loan-loss provisions/allowance remain unresolved.

routes.description: One-row bounded probe confirms local annual Worldscope fields code, year_, and ITEM5350. This is a nearby candidate for accounting data only; it is not established as the authors' Datastream Accounting.dta or mapped to ISIN, FYear, the required accounting fields, sample coverage, or the manual/Capital IQ LLP and LLA supplements.
routes.expected_period: Annual bank accounting observations for the paper sample and years required by LOS_Main.do; exact coverage is unspecified.

requirements.description: LOS_Main.do directly reads Risk_FF.dta as the Bank forward-risk handoff input; required merge contract: one row per ISIN-FYear. IV, IR, and the downstream Stata TRisk field are used later; the MATLAB result uses TR, and the field-name mapping is not supplied. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads Stock_ABR.dta as the Abnormal stock-return handoff input; required merge contract: one row per ISIN-FYear. Downstream Stata uses CABR; the supplied MATLAB function returns BankID, FYear, and ABR but no ISIN, so the required identifier and field conversion are unresolved. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads CDS_ABS.dta as the Abnormal CDS-spread handoff input; required merge contract: one row per ISIN-FYear. This directly merged DTA is absent; the package does not show its producer or prove whether it is the output of the missing CDSABD MATLAB/Excel stage. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads Regl_Supv_index.dta as the Supervisory-intensity handoff input; required merge contract: many master rows per ISIN-FYear, merged m:1 on ISIN FYear. Downstream code uses SupPower_index; no input schema or field ownership is supplied. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads sample_restriction.dta as the Sample inclusion restriction handoff input; required merge contract: many master rows per ISIN, merged m:1 on ISIN. The using file must identify included banks through ResSample. The supplied ISIN_Final_Sample_Banks.xlsx is a candidate identifier list, not an analysis panel; deriving the DTA flag and verifying the complete ISIN values still require preparation. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

routes.description: The documented final-bank identifier workbook is supplied and the bounded static inspection confirms an ISIN column. Its IDs can provide the included-bank list for ResSample; preparing the one-column ISIN list as the DTA merge input with ResSample=1 is a direct identifier-to-flag handoff. The workbook is not an analysis panel, and the bounded probe does not validate every ISIN value or normalization.

requirements.description: LOS_Main.do directly reads Sov_CDS.dta as the Sovereign CDS handoff input; required merge contract: many master rows per Country-FYear, merged m:1 on Country FYear. Downstream code uses Sov_CDS and Sov_CDS18; the codebook, country mapping, units, and coverage are not supplied. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads Loan_Stages.dta as the Loan-by-stage handoff input; required merge contract: many master rows per ISIN-FYear, merged m:1 on ISIN FYear. The DTA is named and merged, but its field schema and source-field ownership are absent; do not infer variables from the separate LLA-by-stage file. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads LLA_Stages.dta as the Loan-loss-allowance-by-stage handoff input; required merge contract: many master rows per ISIN-FYear, merged m:1 on ISIN FYear. Later code uses Stage1_LLA, Stage2_LLA, and Stage3_LLA; the absent schema does not establish all source columns or data transformations. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads ECL_Bank.dta as the Treated-bank indicator handoff input; required merge contract: many master rows per ISIN, merged m:1 on ISIN. The source labels this as a treated-dummy input; the DTA and treatment-variable field contract are not supplied. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

LOS_Main.do directly reads FTA_event_study.dta as the Day-1 impact/event-study handoff input; required merge contract: one row per ISIN-FYear. The relative path already differs from the other /Stata/Raw_data/ reads. The DTA is absent and no producer/schema is supplied. No matching DTA is supplied, and no complete schema/coverage probe is available.

Risk_Ind_calc.m loads Ret_Stock.mat as a daily table whose positional fields are 1 ISIN, 2 FYear, 3 ReportDate, 4 Ret, and 5 Bank_ID. It needs fwd_d subsequent daily rows from each ReportDate==1 within a bank; the exact fwd_d, source Stata-to-MAT producer, ordering, storage types, and historic/edge-row treatment are not supplied.

StockABR_IFRS9_calc.m loads StockABRIFRS9calc.mat as a table with positional fields 1 Bank_ID, 2 Date, 3 ISIN, 4 unused, 5 Ret, 6 FYear, 7 Event_d, 8-10 Fama-French factors, and 11 Rf. The event-window call values, table row ordering/types, stationarity/market-history coverage, and MAT producer are not supplied.

The datasheet specifies an Excel calculation of benchmark CDS using Appendix A of the paper, but this package supplies no calculation workbook, formulas/source ranges, market-data input contract, or manual step instructions. The main paper's Appendix A method is not part of this package's supplementary appendix file; retain its formula and data requirements unresolved.

issues.description: The first stage reads daily close prices, calculates L250.Close_price on a business calendar, and saves the resulting rows directly as past_ret_fyear_end.dta. It does not visibly select fiscal-year-end rows, create FYear, or reduce/check uniqueness before the later 1:1 ISIN FYear merge. Confirm the actual input's date-to-fiscal-year field, row unit, annual selection rule, key cardinality, current working directory, and 250 prior business-day observations required before each reported return. Do not guess a sample-preserving aggregation or filter.

LOS_Main.do line 100 references LLP, NII, TLoan, TSec, and SizeAsset before later gen statements define exact short names at lines 117, 134, 119, 140, and 139. The packaged release contains no merged DTA schemas or Stata setup proving the variable namespace or varabbrev setting. If abbreviations are enabled, a bare name may resolve uniquely to a longer imported variable while the later gen creates a distinct exact short name; an absent/ambiguous resolution or an existing exact name has different behavior. None of these namespace cases is established by the supplied sources. The line order is confirmed, but a source-order failure or the intended sample-preserving correction is not; clarify actual name resolution and intended filter values before changing the filter, variable definitions, or sample.

The two supplied MATLAB functions have no supplied MAT producer or caller. Ret_Stock.mat has a five-column positional table contract and requires a caller-supplied fwd_d; StockABRIFRS9calc.mat has an eleven-column positional contract and requires caller-supplied W_est/W_est_end/W_event values. Their outputs are matrices/text rather than the Stata annual-key DTA contracts: risk output contains TR while Stata consumes TRisk, and the stock-event output positions BankID/FYear/ABR but has no ISIN while Stata merges on ISIN-FYear and consumes CABR. The text export name, file read by Stata, mappings, conversion steps, and source-row order/periods are unresolved.

Ten direct Stata DTA handoffs beyond Close_price_LLP.dta and Accounting.dta are listed as individual requirements, but none is supplied with a codebook/schema or readable data probe. Merge keys are visible in source; field names, types, units, identifier/country mappings, row uniqueness for each declared 1:1 or m:1 join, sample/year coverage, and ownership of downstream fields are not. Keep input ownership unassigned until these schemas are provided.

LOS_Main.do calls tsegen IncomeVol = rowsd(L(0/4).NI_TA,5) after xtset Bank_ID FYear. The actual extension command is not found in the checked Stata adopath, and NI_TA is not generated in the supplied do-file (which generates NI under a different name); its source/definition in a prepared input and availability in another Stata adopath are unverified. The retained panel needs the current and prior four FYear observations for this expression; the exact input-history rule and author intent must be confirmed.

Both supplied MATLAB files call rows(table) to obtain the number of rows. No MATLAB runtime/release or compatibility probe is available, and the code does not identify its intended MATLAB versus other runtime. Preserve the source call until its compatibility is checked in the author's intended environment; do not silently replace it.

The datasheet names absent CDSABD_IFRS9_calc.m and an Excel Appendix-A benchmark-CDS calculation, while Stata consumes CDS_ABS.dta. The supplied online supplementary appendix is not the cited main-paper Appendix A, no Excel calculation workbook/formulas or input contracts are supplied, and no source evidence maps either absent stage directly to CDS_ABS.dta. Obtain the missing producer/hand-off specifications rather than inventing an excess-CDS formula or assuming the identifier workbook is the calculation workbook.

LOS_Main.do mixes eleven absolute /Stata/Raw_data/ reads with one relative Stata/Raw_data/FTA_event_study.dta read and writes intermediates/final output in the current directory. A supported batch setup is a project root containing Stata/Raw_data/ and LOS_Main.do, run with that root as the working directory; the host-visible source/data directory and write permission still require future confirmation.

The last line uses save LOS_main.dta, clear. Stata documents clear for use and replace for overwriting a dataset with save. A one-token source edit to replace is a routine supported correction; future run should confirm output write access in the configured project root.
